_README: TK-2229 backfill input. Maps a NAME that appears inside a historical task
(a repo:<name> tag, or a 'name:' / '[name]' title prefix) to the project_id
that _resolve_project_id would produce for that repository today -- i.e. the
This file exists because the store's own rows use the GitHub repository name
while the project_id is the checkout directory name, and for the BareRouter
repositories those differ. Each entry is verifiable, not a guess:
git -C ~/Code/<project_id> remote get-url origin  ends with  <alias>.git
Run scripts/backfill-project-id.py --verify-aliases to check every row.
Only add an alias you can verify the same way. An unverifiable name belongs
in no rule -- the row stays 'default'.
